title: #lra19 Session: Innovation Systems and Agentive Apprenticeship: Case Study of #IndieWeb and #ds106
summary: Using a theoretical lens of innovation systems this session presents two case studies of open learning spaces: #IndieWeb and #ds106. It concludes by proposing a new model of apprenticeship: agentive apprenticeship. body_html:
Location: Online

Starts (original): Friday, December 6th, 1:00

Ends (original): Friday, December 6th, 1:30

Event timezone: America/New_York

Using a theoretical lens of innovation systems this session presents two case studies of open learning spaces: #IndieWeb and #ds106. It concludes by proposing a  new model of apprenticeship: agentive apprenticeship.

This accounts for the shared goals of the individual and the community while also recognizing knowledge exists in networks as much as people
